qti-content-body.p: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
Deep beneath the surface, this ocean current reverses direction in a ____ pattern that repeats every seven years, completely unrelated to the four seasons on land above it.

Correct! Cyclical best fits here because it describes a pattern that loops back to its starting point and repeats, matching a current that reverses direction and returns every seven years. Seasonal is explicitly ruled out by the sentence's own claim that the pattern is unrelated to the four seasons; periodic only means occurring at regular intervals, without cyclical's specific sense of returning to the same starting state; temporary means lasting only a short while, which doesn't fit something that keeps recurring indefinitely. Cyclical means occurring in cycles; recurring in a regularly repeating pattern that returns to its starting point.
